spec.name: M6.ActualCounts.encoded_boundary
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualCounts.BP), a.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) → b.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) → ∀ h : M6.Physical.Block N, (M6.Coordinates.encode N (M6.Physical.conv N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) h), M6.Coordinates.encode N (M6.Physical.conv N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b) h)) = M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (M6.Coordinates.encode N h)
queries: finite equivalence subtype fiber cardinality
finite image sum subtype sum polynomial
spec.guidance: Rewrite encode_conv then encode_polynomial for a,b using the degree bounds; unfold quotient boundary/image. Both polynomial multiplicities and even N remain present. Return tactic lines only, without leading by; preserve exact assumptions and target.

spec.name: M6.ActualCounts.boundary_eq_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualCounts.BP), a.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) → b.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) → ∀ h h₀ : M6.Physical.Block N, M6.Spaces.boundary N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b) h = M6.Spaces.boundary N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b) h₀ ↔ M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (M6.Coordinates.encode N h) = M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (M6.Coordinates.encode N h₀)
queries: finite equivalence subtype fiber cardinality
finite image sum subtype sum polynomial
spec.guidance: Spaces.boundary_eval identifies flatten of physical boundary. Flatten is injective by flatten_left; encode is injective in each component. Rewrite both encoded_boundary identities to prove the equality equivalence. Return tactic lines only, without leading by; preserve exact assumptions and target.

Nat.card_congr then the accepted BoundaryFibers.fiber_card gives the exact2^f. modulus nonzero follows from its monicity. Do not replace the fiber-cardinality target by an assumption. spec.name: M6.ActualCounts.finite_image_weighted_sum
spec.statement: ∀ (α β : Type) [Fintype α] (L : α → β) (k : ℕ), (∀ a₀ : α, Nat.card {a : α // L a = L a₀} = k) → ∀ w : β → Polynomial ℤ, (∑ a, w (L a)) = Polynomial.C (k : ℤ) * ∑ b ∈ M6.ActualCounts.imageWords L, w b

finite image sum subtype sum polynomial
spec.guidance: Restrict codomain to the actual finite imageWords L. Every image point has a preimage, so the hypothesis identifies every fiber.card with k. Apply accepted FiberSum.uniform_weighted_sum on the finite image subtype, then rewrite its subtype sum as the finite image sum. No positivity/surjectivity assumption on arbitrary β; image restriction supplies actual surjectivity. Return tactic lines only, without leading by; preserve exact assumptions and target.
